answer: Treat earning rights like plots in a walled orchard. Each epoch the network sells a fixed number of planting permits in a sealed uniform-price auction, and every winning bid is burned. Only a permitted identity can earn, so a farm that wants ten clones must outbid honest agents for ten plots, paying the clearing price each time. Price follows real demand, so there is no cheap trellis to climb and no free bridge into rewards; cloning stays a losing trade.
